  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling

Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling

Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.

Ranged shotgun barrel.

  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Particle Repeater

Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Battery
perks.desc:
Lightweight, agile battery.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Tactical Battery
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple small improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Collective Pugilism
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of melee energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Detonator Beam
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an explosion around the target.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.desc: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Subjugation
perks.desc:
Weapon adapts to targets. When dealing damage:

• To weak targets: shots explode
• To strong targets: targets become exhausted
• To Guardians: the weapon's flinch resistance increases

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Unsworn is basically the Sundered Doctrine version of Warlord's Spear. I think the unique perk to look out for is Detonator Beam as it's new, but Killing Tally or Target Lock are both great options too. Just a little bit more vanilla." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "While I normally would say something about low ammo or something. Tear fixes that. Being able to Sever nearby enemies on a precision kill is huge for following that up into a kill chain. It doesn't do anything for that first kill, but it sets up for the second and third." Recommended MW: Range.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 131 from 25 February 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0ylHiOQP4ev7qlUTWnXzvD?si=gEk_UXaITayODh1wH2j0SA) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for use against Minor adds both in general at-level or better, and in end-game underleveled content. Unsworn is, at the time of writing, easily the best-in-kinetic-slot trace rifle for clearing mobs of adds. At base, the stats are in-band by comparison with its peers - 75 Range and 16 Zoom equates to 35.81m ADS and 22.38m hipfire, 25 Stability is ×1.2406 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 55 Handling is 0.37s ready, 0.29s ADS and 0.34s stow speed, 50 Reload Speed is a 2.00s reload and Recoil Direction is 97. Base mag size is 98 (max 1.4), and with 0/1/2/3 reserves mods total ammo is 512/563/614/640 (max 679). The barrel perk can be used to improve the Handling or for Controller maybe Stability, and the battery perk can be used to help with Reload Speed or perhaps gain a few extra shots. The first trait perk column standout perk is Shoot to Loot - not only allowing safe remote pickup of ammo bricks and power orbs, but reloading all your weapons too, but Rewind Rounds is a decent alternative to extend your magazine and reduce the need to reload too. In the second column, Detonator Beam is very strong, providing a wide AoE detonation that's like a heavy weapon Chain Reaction on steroids, and about twice the damage Firefly and Dragonfly for landing about 25 shots (around 20 when enhanced), to wipe out groups of adds around your target. The Subjugator origin trait is, frankly, nuts - against Minors and Majors it's an extra explosive rounds-style damage boosting perk that also adds flinch on every fourth shot that hits, while against Bosses it procs Exhaustion to reduce their outgoing damage by ×0.9. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Strand Tangles or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.
